theorems.name: Submission.dorag_lip_graph_hole_measure_bound
theorems.statement: ∀ (n k : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Euclid (n + k))) (e : Euclid (n + k) → ℝ) (F A B : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (K : ℝ≥0∞) (C₉ R₀ : ℝ), MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ F → (∀ η ∈ A, ∀ r : ℝ, 0 < r → μHE[n] (F ∩ closedBall η r) ≤ K * ENNReal.ofReal (r ^ n)) → (∀ η ∈ A, ∃ s : ℝ, 0 < s ∧ s ≤ R₀ ∧ closedBall η (3 * s) ⊆ B ∧ ENNReal.ofReal (s ^ n) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal C₉ * (μ (closedBall η (3 * s) \ F) + ∫⁻ x in closedBall η (3 * s), ENNReal.ofReal (e x) ∂μ)) → μHE[n] A ≤ K * ENNReal.ofReal (15 ^ n * C₉) * (μ (B \ F) + ∫⁻ x in B, ENNReal.ofReal (e x) ∂μ)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
